commands.review_summary:
Adds a machine-readable Claw update-plan schema, read-only reconciliation planner, focused tests, and a `claws update --dry-run` CLI command over persisted artifact and workspace state.

PR surface: Source +747, Tests +352. Total +1099 across 5 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source with high confidence: apply an artifact-only Claw, then dry-run an update adding its first workspace/persona entry without `--workspace`; the planner reaches the `process.cwd()` fallback.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow mechanical repair can remove the unstable root fallback and add exact regression coverage; accepting the public feature remains a separate maintainer decision.

target.title: Add Claw update dry-run planning
target.body:
## Summary

- Adds `openclaw.clawUpdatePlan.v1` and read-only Claw update/reconcile planning.
- Adds `openclaw claws update <claw> --from <manifest> --dry-run --json` over persisted Claw artifact/workspace state.
- Reports artifact/workspace add, change, remove, unchanged, manual, skipped, and blocked actions without installing, writing files, editing provenance, or touching Gateway.
- Keeps mutating `claws update --yes` fail-closed for the next PR in the RFC #27 update track.

Stack references:
- RFC: openclaw/rfcs#27
- Base PR: openclaw/openclaw#102427
- Next planned PR: consent-gated `claws update --yes` apply

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
Read-only Claw update planning can reconcile an applied Claw against a target manifest and return a machine-readable plan without mutation.

Real environment tested:
WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04, OpenClaw source checkout at `9904dd9e6b7`, local CLI via `node --import tsx src/entry.ts`, temp `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, bundled plugins disabled.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. Applied a local workspace-only Claw with `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-claws-pr11-update-proof/state node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws apply /tmp/openclaw-claws-pr11-update-proof/current/claw.json --yes --workspace /tmp/openclaw-claws-pr11-update-proof/workspace --json`.
2. Previewed a target update with `node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws update starter --from /tmp/openclaw-claws-pr11-update-proof/target/claw.json --dry-run --workspace /tmp/openclaw-claws-pr11-update-proof/workspace --json`.

Evidence after fix:
```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "openclaw.clawUpdatePlan.v1",
  "dryRun": true,
  "mutationAllowed": false,
  "claw": {
    "id": "starter",
    "currentVersion": "1.0.0",
    "targetVersion": "1.1.0"
  },
  "summary": {
    "totalEntries": 2,
    "added": 1,
    "changed": 1,
    "removed": 0,
    "unchanged": 0,
    "manual": 0,
    "blocked": 0,
    "skippedUnsupported": 0
  },
  "entries": [
    { "id": "soul", "kind": "workspaceFile", "phase": "workspace", "action": "change" },
    { "id": "terminal", "kind": "plugin", "phase": "artifact", "action": "add" }
  ]
}
```

Observed result after fix:
The update command returned a read-only plan with one workspace change and one plugin add, with `dryRun: true` and `mutationAllowed: false`.

What was not tested:
Full-project `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs --noEmit --pretty false` timed out after 180s without diagnostics in this linked WSL worktree. A narrowed `--ignoreConfig` command is not meaningful in this repo because it drops path aliases/lib config and emits broad unrelated package-resolution errors.

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/update-plan.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle-state.test.ts src/claws/update-plan.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/claws/types.ts src/claws/update-plan.ts src/claws/update-plan.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.ts src/cli/claws-cli.runtime.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts`
- `codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --uncommitted` after review fixes; final result: no discrete correctness issues found.
